Energy & Inputs.title: Will Crude Oil reach a new all-time high by December 31?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (10% odds) on crude reach the strike. Closes in ~3mo. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in September?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (2% odds) on crude reach $110. Closes in 8d. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $80 in September?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (14% odds) on crude drop below $80. Closes in 8d. A move this low would ease diesel and nitrogen input cost pressure heading into side-dress and summer ops.

Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 96% odds of a rate cut. Lower rates reduce operating loan and land interest carrying cost -- historically supportive of commodity prices via weaker dollar.
